name: Get banner details
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current marketing email status, profile completeness flag, and any related warning message to decide whether to display a banner on the Automation Advanced page. Use the endpoint that fetches automation list instead if you only need automation data.

marketing_email_status.description: The status of the marketing email feature for the account (e.g., "enabled" or "disabled").

is_profile_complete.description: Flag indicating whether the account profile is complete (1 for complete, 0 for incomplete).

err_msg.description: Identifier of the warning message to show when the account is disabled.
